title: A protocol to establish cell line models from rare pediatric solid tumors
protocol: Thaw DNase and Papain aliquots on ice.
Activate the papain by adding 1 mL of activating papain solution to an aliquot of 81 μL papain.
Mix 4 mL of PBS, 100 μL of HEPES, and the activated papain solution in a 15 mL falcon tube.
Filter the mixture through a 0.2 μm syringe filter into a new 15 mL falcon tube.
Transfer the tissue specimen and DMEM/F12 transport media into a 50 mL falcon tube.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Carefully discard the supernatant by manual aspiration after centrifugation.
Transfer the sample to a sterile 10 cm tissue culture dish pre-cooled on ice by tapping the inverted tube onto the dish.
Use a scalpel blade to finely mince the tissue.
Transfer minced tissue into a 50 mL falcon tube using a 25 mL serological pipette by tilting the dish and rinsing with PBS.
Repeat transfer process until all tissue is collected in the conical tube.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard supernatant without disturbing the pellet.
Add activated papain solution to the minced tissue.
Incubate at 37°C in a water bath for 15–20 min.
Swirl the tube every 5 min during incubation.
Add an aliquot of DNase to the tissue after incubation.
Mix by gently swirling the tube.
Add 20 mL of DMEM/F12 wash media to the tissue.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min at 25°C.
Discard the supernatant.
If red blood cells are observed in the cell pellet, add 5 mL of ACK lysis buffer to the cell pellet for 1 min.
Quench with 20 mL of cold HBSS.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant by carefully decanting into waste.
Introduce 3 mL of wash media using a 10 mL serological pipette.
Triturate the cell pellet until no visible large pieces are observed.
If large pieces remain, repeat enzymatic dissociation described in step 7.
Perform a cell count of the cell solution according to your laboratory’s general protocol.
Seed 1–2 million cells per well in a cell culture treated 6-well plate format.
Seed dissociated tumor cells using the media conditions indicated in Table 1.

Cryopreserve 1–3 million cells per vial in cryopreserving media consisting of 500 μL FBS, 100 μL DMSO, and 400 μL cell solution in a Mr Frosty freezing container at -80°C for at least 12 hours before transferring to liquid nitrogen.
Incubate the cells at 37°C and 5% CO2.
At 24 h or 48 h post-seeding, supplement with 1 mL of fresh complete media to each well.
Every 2-3 days post-tissue dissociation, perform a half media change.
Tilt the 6-well plate at an angle if cells are in suspension, allowing them to settle for 5 minutes.
Discard conditioned media from adherent cell plates by removing 500 μl of volume at a time until half of the initial volume is removed.
Supplement with fresh complete media equal to the volume removed.
Monitor cell growth and perform half-media changes every 2-3 days.
Aspirate media from adherent cell cultures and discard into a waste container containing 10% bleach solution.
Rinse cells gently with PBS, ensuring not to disrupt the cells, then aspirate and discard the PBS.
Add 1–2 ml of Accutase to the cells and incubate at 37°C for 3–5 minutes or until cells have visibly detached.
Dilute Accutase by adding 5 times its volume in PBS and collect the cell suspension into a 50 ml falcon tube.
Centrifuge the collected cells at 300 x g for 5 minutes.
Discard the supernatant without disturbing the cell pellet.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 1–5 ml of complete media as needed, perform cell counts and seed according to requirements.
Using a sterile serological pipette, collect all media into a 50 mL falcon tube.
Rinse the surface of the tissue culture plate with PBS and collect all solution into the same falcon tube.
Centrifuge the tube at 300 × g for 5 min.
Discard the supernatant without disturbing the cell pellet.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 1 mL of Accutase.
Incubate at 37°C for 3–5 min.
Manually dissociate spheroids by triturating the solution up and down using a 1 mL pipette.
Dilute Accutase by adding 5× volume of PBS.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min.
Discard the supernatant without disturbing the cell pellet.
Resuspend cell pellet in 1–5 mL of complete media.
Perform cell counts and seeding as required.
